cases.name: Angel Rae Meyers
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Angel was owner and operator of her crafting business “Get Over It Sunshine” in Colorado.  She was taking classes towards her nursing certificate.  She loved her children and was a devoted advocate for Autism."
cases.narrative: He shot and killed her and drove their son, Dane Timms, to a nearby trailhead, where he killed the boy and himself.
